_description: Error envelope returned for ALL non-2xx API responses. Every error in the system — validation failures, missing resources, business rule conflicts, upstream failures — is expressed in this single uniform structure.

_notes.httpStatus: Numeric HTTP status code. Matches the actual HTTP response status.
_notes.httpStatusText: Standard HTTP reason phrase for the status code.
_notes.errorCode: Stable machine-readable identifier. Use this in client code for error branching — never match on the message string as it may change.
_notes.message: Human-readable description. May include dynamic context (e.g. the ID that was not found). Safe to display to end users.

_variant_400_VALIDATION_ERROR._comment: A request field failed bean validation — blank, too long, wrong format, etc.
_variant_400_VALIDATION_ERROR.message: Review text must not be blank

_variant_400_VALIDATION_ERROR_too_long.message: Review text must not exceed 5000 characters

_variant_400_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE._comment: A field value is syntactically valid but semantically incorrect.
_variant_400_INVALID_FIELD_VALUE.message: The provided value is not valid for this field.

_variant_400_MALFORMED_REQUEST._comment: The request body could not be parsed — invalid JSON syntax or missing Content-Type header.
_variant_400_MALFORMED_REQUEST.message: The request body could not be parsed. Please check the JSON syntax and content type.

_variant_404_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND._comment: No review sample exists for the given ID.
_variant_404_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND.message: Review sample with ID 42 was not found.

_variant_409_REVIEW_ALREADY_EXISTS._comment: A review with the same text already exists in the database (unique constraint on reviewText).
_variant_409_REVIEW_ALREADY_EXISTS.message: A review sample with the same text already exists.

_variant_409_MODEL_NOT_TRAINED._comment: A classification was requested but no trained model is available yet. Train the model first.
_variant_409_MODEL_NOT_TRAINED.message: The model has not been trained yet. Please submit labelled samples and trigger a training run first.

_variant_409_INSUFFICIENT_TRAINING_DATA._comment: A training run was requested but fewer labelled samples exist than the configured minimum.
_variant_409_INSUFFICIENT_TRAINING_DATA.message: Insufficient labelled samples for training. Required: 20, available: 5. Submit more labelled reviews or set forceRetrain=true.

_variant_502_CLAUDE_API_UNAVAILABLE._comment: The outbound call to the Anthropic Claude API failed due to a network error or timeout.

_variant_502_CLAUDE_RESPONSE_INVALID._comment: Claude returned a response that could not be parsed into POSITIVE or NEGATIVE.

_variant_500_INTERNAL_ERROR._comment: An unexpected server-side error. Details are logged server-side but intentionally not exposed to the client.
_variant_500_INTERNAL_ERROR.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later or contact support.
